## Implementation

Source modules, offline builders/inputs, native ownership, shared collision/elevation, canonical arrival and usable public approach. Distinguish surveyed information from artistic estimates.

## Activities and access

Arrival → approach → interaction → stop → return/exit. Record persistent poses, seats, doors/platforms and vehicle clearance. Do not imply real-world public access without evidence.

## Asset and rendering cost

Rights/attribution, near/medium geometry and draws, compressed bytes, shared resources, disposal and source hashes. Before/after measurements with comparable settings.

## Verification

Exact commands/results; gameplay browser/device/orientation/route; before/after captures; multiplayer behavior if relevant. Identify isolated model fixtures separately from gameplay. Do not include credentials/private player data.
